name: 黒鉄のハンドガン
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite atlas of the SAME equipment item in four directional views for a small top-down RPG character to hold. Input image is a DESIGN REFERENCE: preserve this item's distinctive silhouette, colors, ornament, materials and identity (黒鉄のハンドガン). Exactly 2 by 2 grid, square canvas. Isolated item centered in each equal quadrant with generous clear padding, no overlaps. Reading order top-left FRONT/down, top-right LEFT, bottom-left RIGHT, bottom-right BACK/up. One fantasy handgun. Front/down view with muzzle foreshortened toward camera, full left-pointing side profile, full right-pointing side profile, back/up view with barrel pointing away. Trigger grip sits toward lower center, at consistent height. Preserve barrel and grip shapes. Crisp chunky pixel-art shading, clearly readable reduced to 20 game pixels, simple metal highlights. No character, hands, arms, ground, floor shadow, scene, labels, lettering, grid, border or extra objects. Transparent background.
